heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Do you support Apple Silicon?
items.answer: Yes. We build and test for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

items.question: Can the same game run on iOS?
items.answer: Yes. Shared code makes iPhone and iPad versions practical.

items.question: Who handles notarization?
items.answer: We do. Signing and notarization are part of the release process.

items.question: How long does mac game development take?
items.answer: A simple casual game takes about 2 to 3 months, while a polished 3D or multiplayer game usually takes 6 months or more.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
